post.summary: Submit a governed Practice, Review, Organization or Task command
post.description: Submit a known typed operation using an explicit native provider. Organization fixed-module preparation has a separate capability and source authority; its availability is disabled until deployment integration is enabled. Source Review uses the historical dna.review.verdict payload with the explicit organization_review_commands capability. Task reassignment uses the separate native Task capability, exact current assignment digest and assignee, and a recipient drawn from its explicit policy. Proposal completion does not establish application or activation.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exactly the configured permitted command origin; never inferred from Host. No null, empty or multiple origins.

200.description: Terminal succeeded, refused or failed receipt; proposal, Review and activation remain separate

202.description: recorded, admitted, running or outcome_unknown receipt; not proof of completion

400.description: invalid_command or invalid_query; malformed, duplicate, unknown or inconsistent input

404.description: command_not_found; absence does not prove a previous in-flight submission cannot later be accepted

405.description: Default provider absence preserves unsupported mutation behavior

409.description: command_context_changed before provider dispatch, stale_subject or request_conflict

503.description: commands_unsupported or commands_unavailable; malformed provider results fail closed

post.summary: Validate an exact next revision against a captured native catalog
post.description: Optional dna.definition.draft.v1 preparation only. Authenticated identity must match the untrusted expected principal. Exact configured Origin, X-Hale-Command: 1, application/json and exactly one canonical Content-Length matching the UTF-8 body bytes are required; Transfer-Encoding, duplicate security/framing headers and every query are refused. Request bytes are bounded at 32768 before strict parsing. Basis and candidate validation, next signed Int64 revision, full-catalog preservation, native preflight and final catalog recapture belong to operations. Record head is rechecked before response. A semantic-invalid candidate returns 200 with validation.valid false and artifact null. Native-valid export is a full captured-catalog registration fragment, not original source roundtrip, publication, activation or a command receipt. Limits: base 65536 bytes, candidate catalog 98304 bytes, 64 definitions, 1024 members. Request and cross-field byte/digest/identity checks are imperative. Draft-native allocation guards limit every decoded workflow/member string to 8192 UTF-8 bytes and the complete candidate catalog text to 16384 bytes before native decode/encode. Exceeding these budgets returns 503, not semantic invalidity. WorkflowCatalogProvider.snapshot remains a trusted host allocation boundary because it supplies an already serialized document; these draft limits do not narrow ordinary Definitions reads.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exactly the configured permitted command origin; never inferred from Host. No null, empty or multiple origins.

parameters.name: Content-Length
parameters.description: Canonical decimal UTF-8 body byte length, exactly once and at most 32768.

200.description: Native validation outcome; no durable state effect

400.description: Malformed draft, unknown fields, inconsistent candidate or any query

404.description: Application or exact base definition revision not found

409.description: Expected principal, captured catalog basis or Record head changed

503.description: Draft validation unsupported, unavailable or native budget refused

post.summary: Check a proposed Hale organization module against its captured assembly
post.description: Optional host opt-in HALE_IRIS_ORG_DRAFTS=1 exposes the fixed committed dna/org/main.hl module. POST requires the authenticated principal, exact source/dependency/module/Record basis, exact Origin, X-Hale-Command: 1, JSON and canonical Content-Length; no queries or duplicate security/framing headers. At most 32768 request bytes, 16384 source bytes and 256 projected instances. The native adapter checks only a disposable captured assembly and never writes the project, Record, dependencies, or running application. All neighboring files retain exact committed bytes. Invalid native source returns 422. Changed source/dependencies/principal/Record returns 409. Response binds exact candidate bytes and static projection to the original source basis. Publication and activation are unavailable. Imperative byte/digest/basis and cross-field checks supplement the schema.

post.summary: Preview ownership source changes without publishing
post.description: Prepares only dna/org/owners through the native DNA Ownership model. Requires exact authenticated principal, source/dependency/module/Record basis, Origin, X-Hale-Command: 1 and canonical JSON framing. Limits: 32768 request bytes, 16384 source bytes and 256 entries. Ambiguous or unsupported source is refused with 422; changed context with 409. Response preserves exact candidate bytes and reports inherited ownership and affected-owner review members. It neither writes source or Record nor establishes active obligations, publication or activation.

post.summary: Submit a head command: project, record, forge, body, secret, model, connection, handoff or observer operation
post.description: The head records the command (command-<digest> identity, fingerprint over the canonical request), admits or refuses it, then executes it: inline operations answer 200 with a terminal receipt; runs and long-lived children answer 202 and settle on the next request. A known request identity with an equal fingerprint returns the stored receipt and never re-executes; a different fingerprint is 409 request_conflict. An inline attach may block up to 15 s while the API child becomes ready.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exactly the head's own origin; never inferred from Host. No null, empty or multiple origins.

200.description: Terminal receipt: succeeded, failed, refused or outcome_unknown

202.description: recorded, admitted or running receipt; not proof of completion

400.description: invalid_command: malformed, unknown, oversize-field or inconsistent input, including a value key on a secret request

503.description: head_detached or head_api_unavailable; retryable
